All transfer eigenvalues have modulus at most one and every unit-modulus eigenvalue is semisimple.
The dihedral operator rank is 2t for t>=6, 2t-1 for t in {1,3,4,5}, and 2 for t=2.
For odd t, the commutant is exactly the span of the dihedral operators.
For odd t<=5, lim_{L->infinity} Kbar(t)=2t-1.
For odd t>=7, lim_{L->infinity} Kbar(t)=2t.
Every even t has an additional singlet-projector commutant sector beyond the dihedral span.
The paper conjectures lim_{L->infinity} Kbar(t)=2t+1 for even t>11.
